data.title: 黑歌 · 竹林月影下的改良旗袍回眸
data.description: 月光穿透修竹林海，黑歌身着高开叉墨色改良旗袍独立于石板小径，猫耳微动，金眸含笑回首。
data.action: 高开叉改良旗袍轻拂修长双腿，单手扶竹侧身回首，猫尾优雅弯曲
data.lighting: 清冷皎洁月光穿透竹叶，形成斑驳银白光影
data.camera: 中景侧后身四分之三机位，景深虚化幽静竹林
data.promptProse: Kuroka pauses along a secluded flagstone pathway winding through a towering bamboo grove under the midnight moon. She wears an alluring black modern cheongsam dress featuring a high side slit outlined in golden thread, highlighting her long legs and curvaceous poise. Resting one hand against a tall bamboo culm, she glances back with twin tails curved gracefully, her golden eyes twinkling with enigmatic allure.
data.animaCaption: Standing beneath the moonlit bamboo canopy in her high-slit black cheongsam, Kuroka turns with an alluring, enigmatic glance.
